_comment: Synthetic offline fixture used by tests/test_quota_control.py.
This file is a hand-authored reproduction of the shape of a CodeBuddy terminal
envelope used by the quota classifier tests. It is NOT a worker report, NOT a
capture of any real session, and NOT an original provider payload. The session
and request identifiers below are obviously synthetic (synthetic-*) placeholders
with no relationship to any real conversation, account, or billing record.
The reset window (2026-10-08 18:14:13 UTC+8) and the 429/status-code-6004 quota
shape are preserved because the tests assert on those semantic facts; the
surrounding identifiers are fabricated on purpose so the fixture can ship with
the public package without exposing any real user/session/request data.
